full_page.content:
1946, January 31
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of the handwritten message on reverse of a printed acknowledgement Card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
(Printed Message)
St. Michael's Church CAPUCHIN FRANCISCAN FATHERS 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N. Y.
Dear Friend :.- God bless you Mrs. Edw'd Wiethoff.
Kindly accept our heartfelt thanks for your Mass offering. The Masses will be said as soon as possible.
With sincere good wishes, we beg to remain
Gratefully yours,
Capuchin Fathers.
(Reverse - In Fr. Solanus' handwriting)
Jan. 31, 1946
God bless you again Mrs. Weithoff. You may well con- gratulate yourself and be consoled that yourself and your lately deceased Mother have been clients of our dear Bles- sed Mother Mary - under whatever title -- for whether as "Mystica Rose" or Mystical City" she remains the Blessed Mother of God and by His divine wisdom and power and mer- ciful condiscention blessed Mother of redeemed humanity, . therefore, our blessed Mother too.
Sincerely yours in Christ - Fr. Solanus, O.F,M,C.
Original in possession of. Mrs. Mary Wiethoff 14 158 Berwick Ave. Livonia, MI. 48154
